name: Short Cut Steak with Sun-Dried Tomato Pesto, Green Beans & Roasted Garlic Couscous

ingredients.name: roasted garlic & olive oil couscous mix

instructions.primary_message: Open spice package from couscous mix and place in a medium saucepan. Add water and oil, then bring to a boil over medium-high heat. Once boiling, remove from heat, add couscous, and stir to combine. Cover and let stand for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (5.8 oz) box roasted garlic & olive oil couscous mix
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat. While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
16 oz striploin (New York strip) steak
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and set aside to rest, 5 minutes. Slice into strips before serving.

Place green beans on a microwave-safe plate and pierce bag with a fork. Microwave on high until tender, 4-5 minutes. Remove from microwave and carefully open the bag. Drizzle with oil and season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (12 oz) bag green beans
extra virgin olive oil
⅛ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide couscous, green beans, and steak between plates. Top steak with pesto and enjoy!
